description: This file defines a migration class for updating the database schema and configuration for version 4.8.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to insert and update configuration entries and a method to return the version number.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMigration, responsible for managing database schema updates and configuration entries for version 4.8.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration by inserting help URL and help processor class configuration, and creating a new entry in the 'ohrm_i18n_group' table.

methods.name: insertConfig
methods.description: Inserts a configuration key-value pair into the 'hs_hr_config' table.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the migration, '4.8'.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Updates an existing configuration entry in the 'hs_hr_config' table.
